description: Attendance is unallocated or threshold-uncertain for multiple local actions. Chernivtsi has only a regional total; several dozen and approximate-50 reports remain uncertain; Jan. 13 Zhytomyr has only an upper bound. Petition totals are not attendance.

description: Some tariff grievances are reported without a named domestic government addressee or explicit state-policy demand. A state venue or crowd threshold alone does not resolve target.

description: Vezha reports Jan. 10 tariff protests in Vinnytsia, Koziatyn and Zhmerynka but its displayed publication date lacks a year and the event year is unstated. Related Suspilne canonical S098 is blocked; AMP S097 remains search-only. These reports are not assigned to Jan. 2021.

description: All unreported response dimensions remain unknown. Actual official engagement supports accommodation only for the Jan. 13 and Jan. 15 Zhytomyr actions. Silence is not ignore; traffic handling, participant blockades, security preventing office entry and police presence do not by themselves establish state crowd dispersal.
required_followup: Seek episode-specific evidence of accommodation, arrests, force, attempted dispersal, refusal, killings or shootings; keep unknown when unreported.

description: Open-web searches in Ukrainian, Russian and English covered January date windows, regions/cities, tariff/energy and labor terms, and December/February continuity. They did not reproduce LexisNexis or systematic local archives; no provider total was exposed. Search results do not prove coverage or absence.
